style: stylized 3D animated comedy, vivid saturated colors, original character design
subject: a female spotted hyena office worker, hunched high withers, big bright tangerine-orange cardigan; she sits in a wide split across three rolling office chairs, front paws typing on two keyboards, tail on the third desk's mouse; three ID badges on lanyards on her neck, two with photos of the same two hyenas as on the desk plaques; dry, serious, never smiles
second_characters: a small nimble rat boss in a lime-green vest, black briefcase under his arm, brisk businesslike moves
props: the hyena's three badges; a thin envelope (the rat's, then pinned to the hyena's lanyard); two cold mugs and two hyena photo plaques on the empty side desks; a floor bin; a wall pay box with a gold coin pictogram; two thick envelopes with the hyena's photo (the rat's); the rat's briefcase; a fourth badge with the rat's photo; the rat's sunglasses
environment: open-plan office, three desks in a row under a ceiling vent grille, plain teal walls, the two outer desks empty
lighting: bright, warm key on her face, magenta rim from the left window, cyan rim from the right; the orange cardigan bright in every shot

light_events.event: a cold glint flashes off the briefcase lock

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one; the hyena fills half the frame, except the close-up beats; her paws never stop typing

audio.delivery: dry flat adult female voice, sarcastic, tired
sfx: loudest: metal click of the briefcase lock 7.5, keys cut to silence

timeline.a: from the first frame, already in a split on three chairs, the hyena types; her three badges swing
timeline.c: camera drops tumbling from the vent into the badges until they fill the frame

timeline.a: the rat kicks her right chair away, her split widens, her tail drags the chair back
the rat pins the thin envelope to her lanyard; her mouth is free and talking, paws typing
timeline.c: camera dives onto her lanyard until the envelope fills the frame

timeline.a: the rat elbows both mugs and both photo plaques off the empty left desk into the bin
timeline.c: camera plunges low into the bin, mug in the foreground

timeline.a: she eyes the bin, shoulders twitch in a silent hyena laugh, the thin envelope on her lanyard
timeline.c: camera whips round from the bin to her eye

timeline.a: the rat pulls two thick envelopes with her photo from the wall pay box; her neck and nose stretch toward them, paws typing
timeline.c: camera arcs up the wall, her nose in the foreground

timeline.a: the rat rams both thick envelopes into his briefcase, snaps the lock and puts on dark sunglasses
timeline.c: camera hurls itself into the briefcase lock until it fills the frame

timeline.a: she slowly turns her head straight into the lens, thin envelope on her lanyard, paws typing, tail on the mouse
timeline.c: camera rockets back and whips round into her eyes until they fill the frame

timeline.a: the rat hangs the fourth badge with his photo on her neck and rolls off on her right chair; four badges swing
timeline.c: camera drops through the chair gap and looks up at the four swinging badges until the rat's photo badge fills the frame

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, a flat medium shot, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
